items.title: Jon Hendricks interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 29, 2000 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: I was surprised when he told me that all he wanted to have was an orchestra that would approach Fletcher Henderson’s.

ctx.x: Well even Ellington had his influences, and that kind of pulled a lot of things together to make his sound.
I was surprised when he told me that all he wanted to have was an orchestra that would approach Fletcher Henderson’s. I said whoa.
